<html lang="ru">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Nomad Lab — медицинская лаборатория в Нукусе</title>
<meta name="description" content="Nomad Laboratories — анализы и УЗИ в Нукусе. ул. А. Досназарова, 78. Прайс-лист 2026, онлайн-запись, результаты в Telegram.">
<!-- Иконка вкладки = круглый логотип NOMAD LAB -->
<link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 400 400'%3E%3Ccircle cx='200' cy='200' r='200' fill='%237b3a96'/%3E%3Cg transform='translate(56.5 150) scale(.7513)' fill='none' stroke='%23fff' stroke-width='12'%3E%3Cpath d='M5.5 70V2L49.5 68V0'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='108' cy='35' r='29.5'/%3E%3Cpath d='M166.5 70V2L196 42L225.5 2V70'/%3E%3Cpath d='M249 70L279 3L309 70'/%3E%3Cpath d='M327 5.5H350A29.5 29.5 0 0 1 350 64.5H327'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3Cg fill='%23fff' font-family='Arial,sans-serif' font-size='30' font-weight='700' text-anchor='middle'%3E%3Ctext x='150' y='272'%3EL%3C/text%3E%3Ctext x='200' y='272'%3EA%3C/text%3E%3Ctext x='250' y='272'%3EB%3C/text%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Nunito:wght@600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    --violet-900: #2f1240;
    --violet-700: #5f2a76;
    --violet-600: #7b3a96;
    --violet-500: #9b59b6;
    --violet-100: #f1e6f7;
    --violet-50:  #f9f3fc;
    --green-600:  #16a34a;
    --green-500:  #22c55e;
    --green-100:  #dcfce7;
    --ink: #221a2b;
    --muted: #6e6479;
    --line: #ebe2f0;
    --bg: #ffffff;
    --radius: 18px;
    --shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(95, 42, 118, .12);
    --grad: linear-gradient(135deg, #7b3a96 0%, #8e44ad 45%, #16a34a 100%);
  }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; text-size-adjust: 100%; }
  img { max-width: 100%; }
  body {
    font-family: "Manrope", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
    color: var(--ink);
    background: var(--bg);
    line-height: 1.6;
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }
  svg { display: block; }
  a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
  button, input, select, textarea { font: inherit; }
  .container { width: min(1180px, 100% - 32px); margin-inline: auto; }
  section { padding: 90px 0; scroll-margin-top: 70px; }
  .section-head { text-align: center; max-width: 680px; margin: 0 auto 48px; }
  .eyebrow {
    display: inline-block; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--green-600); background: var(--green-100);
    padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 999px; margin-bottom: 14px;
  }
  h1, h2, h3 { line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 800; }
  h2 { font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 40px); margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .section-head p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 17px; }

  /* ---------- Кнопки ---------- */
  .btn {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px;
    padding: 14px 26px; border-radius: 999px; border: 2px solid transparent;
    font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .2s, box-shadow .2s, background .2s, color .2s;
    white-space: nowrap; background: none;
  }
  .btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }
  .btn-primary { background: var(--green-500); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(34,197,94,.35); }
  .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--green-600); }
  .btn-violet { background: var(--violet-600); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(123,58,150,.3); }
  .btn-violet:hover { background: var(--violet-700); }
  .btn-outline { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.7); color: #fff; }
  .btn-outline:hover { background: #fff; color: var(--violet-700); }
  .btn-ghost { border-color: var(--violet-600); color: var(--violet-600); }
  .btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--violet-600); color: #fff; }

  /* ---------- Логотип ---------- */
  .logo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
  .logo .mark { width: 46px; height: 46px; flex-shrink: 0; transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), filter .35s; }
  .logo .word { width: 120px; height: 34px; color: var(--violet-600); transition: color .35s; }

  /* Наведение или касание логотипа в шапке: кружок белеет, буквы названия подпрыгивают */
  .logo-anim:hover .mark, .logo-anim:focus-visible .mark, .logo-anim:active .mark {
    --mark-bg: #ffffff;
    --mark-fg: #7b3a96;
    --mark-ring: #7b3a96;
    transform: scale(1.08) rotate(-6deg);
    filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 18px rgba(123,58,150,.35));
  }
  .logo-anim .wl { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: 50% 100%; }
  .logo-anim:hover .wl, .logo-anim:focus-visible .wl, .logo-anim:active .wl { animation: letterJump .62s cubic-bezier(.3,1.4,.5,1); }
  .logo-anim .wl:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0s; }
  .logo-anim .wl:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .07s; }
  .logo-anim .wl:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .14s; }
  .logo-anim .wl:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: .21s; }
  .logo-anim .wl:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: .28s; }
  .logo-anim g:last-of-type .wl:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: .35s; }
  .logo-anim g:last-of-type .wl:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .4s; }
  .logo-anim g:last-of-type .wl:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .45s; }
  .logo-anim:hover .word, .logo-anim:active .word { color: var(--violet-700); }
  @keyframes letterJump {
    0% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
    35% { transform: translateY(-9px) scale(1.12); }
    65% { transform: translateY(2px) scale(.96); }
    100% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .logo-anim:hover .wl, .logo-anim:active .wl { animation: none; }
  }

  /* ---------- Шапка ---------- */
  header {
    position: -webkit-sticky; position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 100;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.92); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 70px; gap: 16px; }
  .menu { display: flex; gap: 8px; list-style: none; }
  /* Кнопки меню: подчёркивание выезжает, фон мягко наливается, активный раздел подсвечен */
  .menu a {
    position: relative; display: inline-block; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted); white-space: nowrap;
    padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden;
    transition: color .28s, background .28s, transform .28s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);
  }
  .menu a::before {
    content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--violet-50);
    transform: scale(.6); opacity: 0; transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), opacity .3s; z-index: -1;
  }
  .menu a::after {
    content: ""; position: absolute; left: 14px; right: 14px; bottom: 5px; height: 2px; border-radius: 2px;
    background: var(--grad); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform .32s cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.3,1);
  }
  .menu a:hover, .menu a:focus-visible { color: var(--violet-700); transform: translateY(-2px); }
  .menu a:hover::before, .menu a:focus-visible::before { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
  .menu a:hover::after, .menu a:focus-visible::after { transform: scaleX(1); }
  .menu a.current { color: var(--violet-700); }
  .menu a.current::after { transform: scaleX(1); }
  .menu a.current::before { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .menu a { transition: color .2s; } .menu a:hover { transform: none; } }
  .nav-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
  .nav-phone { font-weight: 700; color: var(--violet-700); white-space: nowrap; }
  /* Переключатель языков */
  .lang { display: flex; gap: 2px; background: var(--violet-50); border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px; }
  .lang-btn {
    border: 0; background: none; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .03em;
    padding: 6px 9px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .25s, color .25s, transform .25s;
  }
  .lang-btn:hover { color: var(--violet-700); transform: translateY(-1px); }
  .lang-btn.active { background: var(--violet-600); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(123,58,150,.3); }
  @media (max-width: 860px) { .lang { order: -1; } .lang-btn { padding: 6px 7px; font-size: 11px; } }
  .burger { display: none; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 0; background: var(--violet-50); border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; }
  .burger span { display: block; width: 20px; height: 2px; background: var(--violet-700); margin: 4px auto; transition: .3s; }
  .burger.open span:nth-child(1) { transform: translateY(6px) rotate(45deg); }
  .burger.open span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; }
  .burger.open span:nth-child(3) { transform: translateY(-6px) rotate(-45deg); }

  /* ---------- Главный экран ---------- */
  .hero {
    position: relative; color: #fff; padding: 100px 0 120px;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 85% 20%, rgba(34,197,94,.40), transparent 40%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 10% 90%, rgba(155,89,182,.6), transparent 45%),
                linear-gradient(135deg, #2f1240 0%, #5f2a76 60%, #7b3a96 100%);
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .hero::after {
    content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0;
    background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.12) 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size: 26px 26px; pointer-events: none;
  }
  .hero-grid { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(0, .85fr); gap: 50px; align-items: center; }
  .hero-grid > *, .booking-grid > *, .contacts-grid > * { min-width: 0; }
  .badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.14); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25); padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 22px; }
  .badge .dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--green-500); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(34,197,94,.3); }
  .hero h1 { font-size: clamp(34px, 5.5vw, 58px); margin-bottom: 20px; letter-spacing: -.02em; }
  .hero h1 em { font-style: normal; color: #86efac; }
  .hero p.lead { font-size: 19px; opacity: .9; margin-bottom: 32px; max-width: 560px; }
  .prenatal {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; width: 100%; max-width: 560px; margin: 0 0 24px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); border: 1.5px solid rgba(134,239,172,.55); border-radius: 18px;
    padding: 14px 16px; color: #fff; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s, transform .2s;
  }
  .prenatal:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.2); transform: translateY(-2px); }
  .prenatal-ico { width: 46px; height: 46px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--green-500); display: grid; place-items: center; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .prenatal-ico svg { width: 26px; height: 26px; }
  .prenatal-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
  .prenatal-text b { display: block; font-size: 18px; }
  .prenatal-text small { opacity: .8; font-size: 13px; }
  .prenatal-price { font-weight: 800; color: #86efac; white-space: nowrap; }
  @media (max-width: 480px) { .prenatal { flex-wrap: wrap; } .prenatal-price { width: 100%; padding-left: 60px; } }

  /* ---------- Модальное окно отзывов ---------- */
  .modal { position: fixed; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; z-index: 300; display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 16px; background: rgba(20,8,28,.6); }
  .modal.open { display: flex; }
  .modal-box { background: #fff; border-radius: 24px; width: min(760px, 100%); max-height: calc(100vh - 32px); max-height: calc(100dvh - 32px); display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.35); }
  .modal-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 20px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .modal-head h3 { font-size: 22px; }
  .modal-head small { color: var(--muted); display: block; }
  .modal-close { width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 12px; border: 0; background: var(--violet-50); color: var(--violet-700); font-size: 24px; cursor: pointer; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .modal-close:hover { background: var(--violet-100); }
  .modal-body { overflow-y: auto; padding: 20px 24px; display: grid; gap: 14px; }
  .modal-body .review { padding: 20px; }
  body.no-scroll { overflow: hidden; }

  /* ---------- Значок корзины в шапке ---------- */
  .cart-icon {
    position: relative; width: 46px; height: 46px; border-radius: 14px; border: 0; cursor: pointer;
    background: var(--green-500); color: #fff; display: grid; place-items: center;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(34,197,94,.35); transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), background .25s;
  }
  .cart-icon:hover { transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.06); background: var(--green-600); }
  .cart-icon svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }
  .cart-badge {
    position: absolute; top: -6px; right: -6px; min-width: 22px; height: 22px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--violet-600); color: #fff; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; display: grid; place-items: center;
    border: 2px solid #fff; transform: scale(0); transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);
  }
  .cart-badge.show { transform: scale(1); }
  .cart-badge.bump { animation: badgeBump .45s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1); }
  @keyframes badgeBump { 0% { transform: scale(1); } 40% { transform: scale(1.45); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } }

  /* ---------- Окно корзины ---------- */
  .cart-box { width: min(640px, 100%); }
  .cart-modal.open .modal-box { animation: cartIn .38s cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.3,1); }
  @keyframes cartIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(26px) scale(.97); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
  .cart-modal .modal-body { display: block; }
  .cart-empty { text-align: center; padding: 30px 10px; display: none; }
  .cart-empty-ico { font-size: 52px; margin-bottom: 8px; animation: cartBob 2.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
  @keyframes cartBob { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-6px) rotate(-6deg); } }
  .cart-empty b { display: block; font-size: 19px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .cart-empty p { color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 18px; }
  .cart-items { list-style: none; display: grid; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
  .cart-items li {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: var(--violet-50); border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 14px; padding: 12px 12px 12px 16px; animation: fadeUp .35s both;
  }
  .cart-items .ci-name { flex: 1; min-width: 0; font-weight: 600; }
  .cart-items .ci-name small { display: block; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; }
  .cart-items .ci-price { font-weight: 800; color: var(--violet-700); white-space: nowrap; }
  .ci-del {
    width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; border: 0; background: #fff; color: var(--muted);
    font-size: 18px; cursor: pointer; flex-shrink: 0; transition: background .2s, color .2s, transform .2s;
  }
  .ci-del:hover { background: #ef4444; color: #fff; transform: rotate(90deg); }
  .cart-total {
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 16px 18px; border-radius: 16px;
    background: var(--grad); color: #fff; font-weight: 700;
  }
  .cart-total b { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; }
  .cart-paynote { color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; margin: 10px 2px 22px; }
  .cart-subtitle { font-size: 17px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .cart-submit { width: 100%; margin-top: 16px; }
  .order-no { display: inline-block; background: var(--violet-50); border: 1px dashed var(--violet-500); border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 16px; margin-bottom: 18px; font-size: 14px; animation: fadeUp .5s .42s both; }
  .order-no b { color: var(--violet-700); letter-spacing: .04em; }
  .cart small#cartPay { opacity: .6; }

  /* ---------- Шрифт раздела «Услуги»: мягкий, округлый ---------- */
  #services, #services .direction { font-family: "Nunito", "Manrope", system-ui, sans-serif; }
  #services h2 { font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
  #services .section-head p { font-weight: 600; }
  .direction b { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .005em; }
  .direction .cnt { font-weight: 700; }
  .direction .from { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 900; }
  .reviews-actions { display: flex; justify-content: center; margin-top: 28px; }
  .tg-hint { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); }
  .tg-hint a { color: var(--violet-600); font-weight: 700; }
  .hero-buttons { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; }
  .stats { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 36px; margin-top: 46px; }
  .stat b { display: block; font-size: 32px; font-weight: 800; }
  .stat span { opacity: .8; font-size: 14px; }
  .hero-card {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.1); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);
    border-radius: 28px; padding: 30px; -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px); backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  }
  .check { width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--green-500); display: grid; place-items: center; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .check svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

  /* ---------- Видео-лента ---------- */
  .feed-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .feed-head b { font-size: 18px; }
  .feed-head small { opacity: .75; font-size: 13px; white-space: nowrap; }
  .feed { position: relative; }
  .feed-track {
    position: relative; /* чтобы offsetLeft видео не зависел от прокрутки */
    display: flex; gap: 14px; overflow-x: auto; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
    scroll-behavior: smooth; padding-bottom: 4px; outline: none;
    scrollbar-width: none; -ms-overflow-style: none;
  }
  .feed-track::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
  .feed-track:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(134,239,172,.7); border-radius: 20px; }
  .feed-item {
    position: relative; flex: 0 0 100%; scroll-snap-align: center; border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden;
    aspect-ratio: 9 / 16; max-height: 500px; background: rgba(0,0,0,.25); display: grid; place-items: center;
  }
  /* постер в ленте */
  .feed-item.poster {
    aspect-ratio: 1410 / 1850; max-height: none; border: 0; padding: 0; cursor: zoom-in;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,.25); color: #fff; font: inherit; text-align: left;
  }
  .feed-item.poster img {
    position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block;
    transition: transform .6s cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.3,1);
  }
  .feed-item.poster:hover img, .feed-item.poster:focus-visible img { transform: scale(1.04); }
  /* старые браузеры без aspect-ratio: держим пропорции постера через padding */
  @supports not (aspect-ratio: 1 / 1) {
    .feed-item.poster { height: 0; padding-top: 131.2%; }
    .feed-item { height: 0; padding-top: 177.7%; }
  }
  .feed-item.poster .feed-open { padding: 8px; }
  .feed-item.poster .feed-open svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
  .feed-item.poster:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #86efac; outline-offset: 2px; }
  /* у постера свой заголовок — подпись показываем только для экранных чтецов */
  .feed-item.poster .feed-caption { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); padding: 0; }

  /* просмотр постера крупно */
  .poster-modal { background: rgba(10,4,16,.86); }
  .poster-modal img {
    max-width: min(760px, 100%); max-height: calc(100vh - 32px); max-height: calc(100dvh - 32px); width: auto; height: auto;
    border-radius: 18px; box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.5); animation: cartIn .35s cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.3,1);
  }
  .poster-close { position: fixed; top: 16px; right: 16px; z-index: 2; }
  .feed-item video { position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; background: #16081f; }
  /* большая кнопка «play» поверх ролика */
  .feed-play {
    position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; z-index: 3; width: 72px; height: 72px; margin: -36px 0 0 -36px;
    border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7); background: rgba(123,58,150,.55); color: #fff;
    display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px); backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
    transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), background .25s, opacity .25s;
    animation: playPulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .feed-play svg { width: 30px; height: 30px; margin-left: 4px; }
  .feed-play:hover { transform: scale(1.12); background: var(--green-500); border-color: var(--green-500); }
  @keyframes playPulse { 0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(134,239,172,.55); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 18px rgba(134,239,172,0); } }
  .feed-item.playing .feed-play, .feed-item.playing .feed-caption { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
  .feed-item .feed-caption { transition: opacity .3s; }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .feed-play { animation: none; } }

  /* ---------- Видео из соцсетей ---------- */
  /* встраивание растягиваем на весь слайд: height:100% в grid-ячейке не работает */
  .feed-item iframe { position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0; display: block; background: #16081f; z-index: 1; }
  .feed-open {
    position: absolute; right: 10px; top: 10px; z-index: 3; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
    background: rgba(20,8,28,.62); color: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3); border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 7px 13px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); transition: background .25s, transform .25s;
  }
  .feed-open:hover { background: var(--green-500); border-color: var(--green-500); transform: translateY(-2px); }
  .feed-open svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

  .feed-caption {
    position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 2; padding: 48px 16px 16px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px;
    background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(20,8,28,.92)); pointer-events: none;
  }
  .feed-arrow {
    position: absolute; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); z-index: 2;
    width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);
    background: rgba(20,8,28,.55); color: #fff; cursor: pointer; display: grid; place-items: center;
    transition: background .2s, transform .2s, opacity .2s; -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px); backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  }
  .feed-arrow svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; }
  .feed-arrow.prev { left: -14px; }
  .feed-arrow.next { right: -14px; }
  .feed-arrow:hover { background: var(--green-500); border-color: var(--green-500); transform: translateY(-50%) scale(1.1); }
  .feed-arrow[disabled] { opacity: .3; cursor: default; transform: translateY(-50%); }
  .feed-dots { display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: center; margin-top: 14px; }
  .feed-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; border: 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(255,255,255,.35); cursor: pointer; transition: .25s; }
  .feed-dot.active { background: var(--green-500); width: 22px; border-radius: 5px; }
  @media (max-width: 860px) { .feed-arrow.prev { left: 6px; } .feed-arrow.next { right: 6px; } }

  /* ---------- Преимущества ---------- */
  .features { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 22px; }
  .feature {
    position: relative; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 28px;
    overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate;
    transition: transform .4s cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.3,1), box-shadow .4s, border-color .4s;
  }
  /* Появление карточек по очереди (задержка только при появлении, не при наведении) */
  .feature.reveal { transition: opacity .6s, transform .5s cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.3,1), box-shadow .4s, border-color .4s; }
  .feature:nth-child(2):not(:hover) { transition-delay: .09s; }
  .feature:nth-child(3):not(:hover) { transition-delay: .18s; }
  .feature:nth-child(4):not(:hover) { transition-delay: .27s; }
  /* Мягкая подсветка, которая наплывает снизу */
  .feature::before {
    content: ""; position: absolute; top: auto; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; height: 100%; z-index: -1;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(241,230,247,0) 0%, var(--violet-50) 100%);
    transform: translateY(100%); transition: transform .45s cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.3,1);
  }
  /* .visible в селекторе — чтобы подъём не перебивался анимацией появления */
  .feature:hover, .feature.visible:hover { transform: translateY(-10px); box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgba(95,42,118,.16); border-color: var(--violet-500); }
  .feature:hover::before { transform: translateY(0); }
  .icon {
    width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 16px; display: grid; place-items: center; margin-bottom: 18px;
    background: var(--violet-100); color: var(--violet-600);
    transition: transform .45s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), background .35s, color .35s, border-radius .45s;
  }
  .feature:nth-child(even) .icon { background: var(--green-100); color: var(--green-600); }
  .feature:hover .icon { transform: translateY(-4px) rotate(-8deg) scale(1.1); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--violet-600); color: #fff; }
  .feature:nth-child(even):hover .icon { background: var(--green-500); color: #fff; }
  .icon svg { width: 28px; height: 28px; }
  .feature h3 { font-size: 19px; margin-bottom: 8px; transition: color .3s, transform .35s; }
  .feature:hover h3 { color: var(--violet-700); transform: translateX(4px); }
  .feature p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 15px; }

  /* ---------- Направления ---------- */
  .directions { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 18px; }
  .direction {
    text-align: left; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: #fff; border-radius: var(--radius);
    padding: 24px; cursor: pointer; transition: .25s; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink);
  }
  .direction:hover, .direction.visible:hover { border-color: var(--violet-500); box-shadow: var(--shadow); transform: translateY(-6px) scale(1.02); }
  .direction b { font-size: 18px; }
  .direction .cnt { color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; }
  .direction .from { margin-top: 8px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--violet-700); }
  .direction .from small { font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted); }
  .directions { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
  .direction.hot { background: var(--grad); color: #fff; border: 0; }
  .direction.hot .cnt, .direction.hot .from, .direction.hot .from small { color: #fff; }

  /* ---------- Цены ---------- */
  #prices { background: var(--violet-50); }
  .price-tools { display: grid; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 24px; }
  .tabs { display: flex; gap: 8px; overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 6px; scrollbar-width: thin; }
  .tab { flex-shrink: 0; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: #fff; padding: 9px 16px; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; color: var(--muted); transition: .2s; font-size: 14px; }
  .tab:hover { color: var(--violet-600); border-color: var(--violet-500); }
  .tab.active { background: var(--violet-600); color: #fff; border-color: var(--violet-600); }
  .search { position: relative; max-width: 460px; }
  .search input { width: 100%; padding: 13px 16px 13px 46px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; outline: none; transition: border .2s, box-shadow .2s; color: var(--ink); }
  .search input:focus { border-color: var(--violet-500); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(155,89,182,.18); }
  .search svg { position: absolute; left: 17px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 18px; height: 18px; color: var(--muted); }
  .price-table { background: #fff; border-radius: var(--radius); box-shadow: var(--shadow); overflow: hidden; }
  .price-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 190px 130px; gap: 12px; align-items: center; padding: 14px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .price-row.head { background: var(--violet-900); color: #fff; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; }
  .price-row.group { background: var(--violet-100); color: var(--violet-700); font-weight: 800; font-size: 14px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; padding: 10px 24px; display: block; }
  .price-row.item:hover { background: #fcf9fe; }
  .p-name b { display: block; font-weight: 600; }
  .p-name small { color: var(--muted); }
  .p-price { font-weight: 800; color: var(--violet-700); font-size: 17px; white-space: nowrap; }
  .p-price.incl { font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); white-space: normal; }
  .add-btn { border: 0; background: var(--green-100); color: var(--green-600); font-weight: 700; padding: 9px 14px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: .2s; }
  .add-btn:hover { background: var(--green-500); color: #fff; }
  .add-btn.added { background: var(--green-500); color: #fff; }
  .empty { padding: 40px; text-align: center; color: var(--muted); display: none; }
  .more-wrap { text-align: center; margin-top: 20px; display: none; }
  .price-note { margin-top: 16px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted); text-align: center; }

  .cart {
    position: fixed; right: 20px; bottom: 20px; z-index: 90;
    background: var(--violet-900); color: #fff; border-radius: 20px; padding: 14px 16px 14px 20px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(47,18,64,.4);
    transform: translateY(160%); transition: transform .35s; max-width: calc(100% - 40px);
  }
  .cart.show { transform: translateY(0); }
  .cart small { display: block; opacity: .7; font-size: 12px; }
  .cart b { font-size: 18px; white-space: nowrap; }
  .cart .btn { padding: 10px 18px; }
  .cart-clear { background: none; border: 0; color: rgba(255,255,255,.6); cursor: pointer; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1; padding: 4px; }
  .cart-clear:hover { color: #fff; }

  /* ---------- Запись ---------- */
  #booking { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2f1240, #5f2a76); color: #fff; }
  .booking-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, .9fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr); gap: 50px; align-items: start; }
  #booking .eyebrow { background: rgba(34,197,94,.2); color: #86efac; }
  #booking h2 + p { opacity: .85; margin-bottom: 28px; font-size: 17px; }
  .steps { list-style: none; display: grid; gap: 18px; counter-reset: s; }
  .steps li { display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: flex-start; }
  .steps li::before { counter-increment: s; content: counter(s); width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--green-500); display: grid; place-items: center; font-weight: 800; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .steps b { display: block; }
  .steps span { opacity: .8; font-size: 15px; }
  form.card { background: #fff; color: var(--ink); border-radius: 26px; padding: 34px; box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.25); }
  .form-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
  .field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; }
  .field.full { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
  .field > label { font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; }
  .field input, .field select, .field textarea {
    border: 1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; outline: none; background: #fff; color: var(--ink);
    transition: border .2s, box-shadow .2s; width: 100%;
  }
  .field textarea { resize: vertical; min-height: 90px; }
  .field input:focus, .field select:focus, .field textarea:focus { border-color: var(--violet-500); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(155,89,182,.18); }
  .field.error input, .field.error select, .field.error textarea { border-color: #ef4444; }
  .err { color: #ef4444; font-size: 13px; min-height: 18px; }
  .radio-row { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .radio-row label { flex: 1; min-width: 130px; border: 1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 11px 14px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
  .radio-row input { accent-color: var(--violet-600); width: auto; }
  .radio-row label:has(input:checked) { border-color: var(--violet-600); background: var(--violet-50); }
  form.card .btn[type=submit] { width: 100%; margin-top: 18px; }
  .success { display: none; text-align: center; padding: 10px 0; }
  .success h3 { font-size: 24px; margin-bottom: 8px; animation: fadeUp .5s .25s both; }
  .success p { color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 20px; animation: fadeUp .5s .35s both; }
  .success .btns { display: flex; gap: 10px; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; animation: fadeUp .5s .95s both; }

  /* Вспышка с галочкой */
  .success-burst { position: relative; width: 110px; height: 110px; margin: 0 auto 14px; display: grid; place-items: center; }
  .success .check { width: 76px; height: 76px; animation: popIn .6s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) both; }
  .success .check svg { width: 38px; height: 38px; }
  .check-path { stroke-dasharray: 26; stroke-dashoffset: 26; animation: drawCheck .45s .38s ease-out forwards; }
  .success-burst .ring {
    position: absolute; top: 14px; right: 14px; bottom: 14px; left: 14px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid var(--green-500);
    animation: ringOut 1.5s .3s ease-out infinite;
  }
  .success-burst .ring.r2 { animation-delay: .9s; }
  .success-burst .spark {
    position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--violet-500);
    animation: spark .9s .35s ease-out both;
  }
  .success-burst .s1 { --tx: 0px;   --ty: -62px; background: var(--green-500); }
  .success-burst .s2 { --tx: 55px;  --ty: -30px; }
  .success-burst .s3 { --tx: 55px;  --ty: 32px;  background: #f59e0b; }
  .success-burst .s4 { --tx: 0px;   --ty: 60px;  background: var(--green-500); }
  .success-burst .s5 { --tx: -55px; --ty: 30px; }
  .success-burst .s6 { --tx: -55px; --ty: -32px; background: #f59e0b; }
  @keyframes spark {
    0% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(.2); opacity: 0; }
    40% { opacity: 1; }
    100% { transform: translate(calc(-50% + var(--tx)), calc(-50% + var(--ty))) scale(1) rotate(180deg); opacity: 0; }
  }
  @keyframes popIn { 0% { transform: scale(0) rotate(-40deg); } 100% { transform: scale(1) rotate(0); } }
  @keyframes drawCheck { to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }
  @keyframes ringOut { 0% { transform: scale(.7); opacity: .8; } 100% { transform: scale(1.5); opacity: 0; } }
  @keyframes fadeUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(14px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }

  /* Список деталей записи */
  .success-list { list-style: none; display: grid; gap: 10px; text-align: left; margin-bottom: 22px; }
  .success-list .sl {
    display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: flex-start; background: var(--violet-50);
    border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 16px; padding: 14px 16px;
  }
  .success-list .s-1 { animation: fadeUp .5s .5s both; }
  .success-list .s-2 { animation: fadeUp .5s .62s both; }
  .success-list .s-3 { animation: fadeUp .5s .74s both; }
  .success-list .s-4 { animation: fadeUp .5s .86s both; }
  .success-list .pay { background: var(--green-100); border-color: rgba(34,197,94,.45); }
  .sl-ico { font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.2; }
  .success-list small { display: block; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; }
  .success-list b { display: block; font-size: 16px; }
  .success-list em { display: block; font-style: normal; color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .success *, .success-burst * { animation: none !important; }
    .check-path { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
  }

  /* ---------- Отзывы ---------- */
  .rating-box { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 18px; margin-bottom: 40px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .rating-box .big { font-size: 56px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--violet-700); line-height: 1; }
  .stars { color: #f59e0b; letter-spacing: 2px; font-size: 20px; }
  .rating-box small { color: var(--muted); display: block; }
  .reviews { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 22px; }
  .review { position: relative; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 26px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
  /* Крестик появляется только у отзывов, оставленных на сайте */
  .review-del {
    position: absolute; top: 12px; right: 12px; width: 30px; height: 30px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--violet-50); color: var(--muted); font-size: 18px; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer;
    opacity: 0; transform: scale(.85); transition: opacity .25s, transform .25s, background .25s, color .25s;
  }
  .review:hover .review-del, .review:focus-within .review-del { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
  .review-del:hover, .review-del:focus-visible { background: #ef4444; color: #fff; opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.08); }
  @media (hover: none) { .review-del { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
  .review p { color: #3d3447; flex: 1; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .author { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; cursor: pointer; }
  .avatar {
    width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; color: #fff; font-weight: 800;
    background: var(--grad); flex-shrink: 0; border: 2px solid transparent;
    transition: background .35s, color .35s, border-color .35s, transform .35s, box-shadow .35s;
  }
  /* Наведение или касание аватарки: она становится белой, имя оживает */
  .author:hover .avatar, .author:focus-within .avatar, .avatar:active {
    background: #fff; color: var(--violet-700); border-color: var(--violet-600);
    transform: scale(1.12) rotate(-6deg); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(123,58,150,.28);
  }
  .author b { display: inline-block; position: relative; transition: color .3s, transform .3s; }
  .author b::after {
    content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: -2px; height: 2px; width: 100%;
    background: var(--grad); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform .35s;
  }
  .author:hover b, .author:focus-within b { color: var(--violet-600); transform: translateX(4px); }
  .author:hover b::after, .author:focus-within b::after { transform: scaleX(1); }
  .author small { display: block; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; }
  .review-form { max-width: 720px; margin: 46px auto 0; background: var(--violet-50); border-radius: 24px; padding: 30px; }
  .review-form h3 { margin-bottom: 16px; font-size: 20px; }
  .star-input { display: flex; gap: 4px; flex-direction: row-reverse; justify-content: flex-end; }
  .star-input input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 1px; height: 1px; }
  .star-input label { font-size: 30px; color: #d9d0df; cursor: pointer; transition: color .15s; line-height: 1; }
  .star-input label:hover, .star-input label:hover ~ label, .star-input input:checked ~ label { color: #f59e0b; }
  /* Выбранные звёзды подпрыгивают по очереди */
  .star-input label.jump { animation: starJump .55s cubic-bezier(.3,1.5,.5,1); }
  @keyframes starJump {
    0% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1) rotate(0); }
    35% { transform: translateY(-12px) scale(1.3) rotate(-10deg); }
    65% { transform: translateY(3px) scale(.92) rotate(4deg); }
    100% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1) rotate(0); }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .star-input label.jump { animation: none; } }
  .star-input input:focus-visible + label { outline: 2px solid var(--violet-500); border-radius: 4px; }

  /* ---------- Контакты ---------- */
  #contacts { background: var(--violet-50); }
  .contacts-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.2fr); gap: 28px; }
  .contact-card { background: #fff; border-radius: 24px; padding: 32px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); display: grid; gap: 22px; align-content: start; }
  .c-item { display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: flex-start; }
  .c-item .icon { margin: 0; width: 48px; height: 48px; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .c-item .icon svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; }
  .c-item small { color: var(--muted); display: block; font-size: 13px; }
  .c-item b { font-size: 17px; }
  .socials { display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .social { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 14px; display: grid; place-items: center; color: #fff; transition: transform .2s; }
  .social:hover { transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.05); }
  .social svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; }
  .s-ig { background: linear-gradient(45deg, #f59e0b, #ec4899, #8b5cf6); }
  .s-tg { background: #229ed9; }
  .s-wa { background: var(--green-500); }
  .map { border-radius: 24px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: var(--shadow); min-height: 420px; background: #e8e2ec; }
  .map iframe { width: 100%; height: 100%; min-height: 420px; border: 0; display: block; }

  /* ---------- Подвал ---------- */
  footer { background: var(--violet-900); color: rgba(255,255,255,.75); padding: 50px 0 30px; }
  .foot { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 30px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; }
  footer .logo .word { color: #fff; }
  .foot-links { display: flex; gap: 22px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .foot-links a:hover { color: #86efac; }
  .copy { border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12); margin-top: 30px; padding-top: 20px; font-size: 14px; text-align: center; }

  .toast { position: fixed; left: 50%; top: 86px; transform: translate(-50%, -30px); background: var(--green-600); color: #fff; padding: 12px 22px; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 700; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: .3s; z-index: 200; box-shadow: var(--shadow); max-width: calc(100% - 32px); text-align: center; }
  .toast.show { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, 0); }
  .toast.bad { background: #ef4444; }

  .reveal { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px); transition: opacity .7s, transform .7s; }
  .reveal.visible { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: none; transition: none; } html { scroll-behavior: auto; } }

  /* ---------- Адаптив ---------- */
  @media (max-width: 1280px) { .nav-phone { display: none; } }
  @media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .features, .directions { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    .reviews { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 860px) {
    section { padding: 64px 0; }
    .menu {
      position: absolute; top: 70px; left: 0; right: 0; flex-direction: column; gap: 0;
      background: #fff; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); display: none; padding: 8px 16px 16px;
      box-shadow: 0 20px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.08);
    }
    .menu.open { display: flex; }
    .menu a { display: block; padding: 12px 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
    .burger { display: block; }
    .nav-actions .btn { display: none; }
    .hero { padding: 60px 0 80px; }
    .hero-grid, .booking-grid, .contacts-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
    /* на планшете постер не растягиваем на весь экран */
    .hero-card { width: 100%; max-width: 460px; justify-self: center; margin: 0 auto; }
    .price-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; padding: 14px 16px; row-gap: 8px; }
    .price-row .p-name { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
    .price-row.group { padding: 10px 16px; }
    .price-row.head { display: none; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 620px) {
    .features, .reviews, .form-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .stats { gap: 22px; }
    form.card, .contact-card, .review-form { padding: 22px; }
    .logo .word { width: 100px; }
    .cart { left: 16px; right: 16px; max-width: none; justify-content: space-between; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 400px) {
    .directions { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }
  /* узкие телефоны: в шапке только круглый логотип, чтобы поместились языки и корзина */
  @media (max-width: 520px) {
    .logo .word { display: none; }
    .nav { gap: 10px; }
    .nav-actions { gap: 8px; }
    .cart-icon, .burger { width: 42px; height: 42px; }
    .lang-btn { padding: 6px 6px; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ========== ЛОГОТИП NOMAD LAB (SVG) ========== -->
<svg width="0" height="0" style="position:absolute" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
  <!-- Буквы NOMAD: цвет берётся из currentColor -->
  <symbol id="nomad-letters" viewBox="-6 -6 394 82">
    <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="11" stroke-linejoin="miter">
      <path d="M5.5 70V2L49.5 68V0"/>
      <circle cx="108" cy="35" r="29.5"/>
      <path d="M166.5 70V2L196 42L225.5 2V70"/>
      <path d="M249 70L279 3L309 70"/>
      <path d="M327 5.5H350A29.5 29.5 0 0 1 350 64.5H327"/>
    </g>
  </symbol>
  <!-- Круглый логотип -->
  <symbol id="logo" viewBox="0 0 400 400">
    <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="196" fill="var(--mark-bg, #7b3a96)" stroke="var(--mark-ring, transparent)" stroke-width="8"/>
    <use href="#nomad-letters" x="52" y="150" width="296" height="62" style="color: var(--mark-fg, #fff)"/>
    <g fill="var(--mark-fg, #fff)" font-family="Manrope, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="500" text-anchor="middle">
      <text x="160" y="266">L</text>
      <text x="200" y="266">A</text>
      <text x="240" y="266">B</text>
    </g>
  </symbol>
  <!-- Надпись для шапки -->
  <symbol id="wordmark" viewBox="0 0 400 110">
    <use href="#nomad-letters" x="0" y="0" width="400" height="84"/>
    <g fill="currentColor" font-family="Manrope, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="600" text-anchor="middle">
      <text x="150" y="110">L</text>
      <text x="200" y="110">A</text>
      <text x="250" y="110">B</text>
    </g>
  </symbol>
</svg>

<!-- ========== ШАПКА ========== -->
<header>
  <div class="container nav">
    <a href="#home" class="logo logo-anim" aria-label="Nomad Lab — на главную">
      <svg class="mark" role="img" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#logo"/></svg>
      <!-- Название написано отдельными буквами, чтобы они подпрыгивали при наведении -->
      <svg class="word" viewBox="-6 -6 412 122" aria-hidden="true">
        <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="11" stroke-linejoin="miter">
          <path class="wl" d="M5.5 70V2L49.5 68V0"/>
          <circle class="wl" cx="108" cy="35" r="29.5"/>
          <path class="wl" d="M166.5 70V2L196 42L225.5 2V70"/>
          <path class="wl" d="M249 70L279 3L309 70"/>
          <path class="wl" d="M327 5.5H350A29.5 29.5 0 0 1 350 64.5H327"/>
        </g>
        <g fill="currentColor" stroke="none" font-family="Manrope, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="600" text-anchor="middle">
          <text class="wl" x="150" y="110">L</text>
          <text class="wl" x="200" y="110">A</text>
          <text class="wl" x="250" y="110">B</text>
        </g>
      </svg>
    </a>
    <ul class="menu" id="menu">
      <li><a href="#about" data-i18n="nav.about">О нас</a></li>

        <button type="button" class="lang-btn" data-lang="uz">UZ</button>
        <button type="button" class="lang-btn" data-lang="en">EN</button>
        <button type="button" class="lang-btn" data-lang="ru">RU</button>
      </div>
      <a class="nav-phone" href="tel:+998996944444">+998 99 694 44 44</a>
      <button type="button" class="cart-icon" data-open-cart aria-label="Открыть корзину">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 4h2l2.4 11.2a2 2 0 0 0 2 1.6h7.7a2 2 0 0 0 2-1.5L21 8H6.2"/><circle cx="10" cy="20.5" r="1.3"/><circle cx="17" cy="20.5" r="1.3"/></svg>

      <button class="burger" id="burger" type="button" aria-label="Открыть меню" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="menu"><span></span><span></span><span></span></button>
    </div>
  </div>
</header>

<main>
<!-- ========== ГЛАВНЫЙ ЭКРАН ========== -->
<section class="hero" id="home">
  <div class="container hero-grid">
    <div>
      <div class="badge"><span class="dot"></span> <span data-i18n="hero.badge">Нукус · ул. А. Досназарова, 78</span></div>
      <h1 data-i18n="hero.title" data-i18n-html="1">Nomad Lab — <em>точные анализы</em> и УЗИ в Нукусе</h1>
      <button type="button" class="prenatal" id="prenatalHero" aria-label="Открыть цены на пренатальный скрининг">
        <span class="prenatal-ico" aria-hidden="true">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="5" r="2.5"/><path d="M12 8c-3 0-5 2.5-5 5.5 0 2 1 3.5 2.5 4.2V21h5v-3.3c1.5-.7 2.5-2.2 2.5-4.2C17 10.5 15 8 12 8z"/><circle cx="12" cy="13.5" r="2"/></svg>
        </span>
        <span class="prenatal-text">
          <b data-i18n="hero.prenatal">Пренатальный скрининг</b>
          <small id="prenatalList">Свободный β-ХГЧ · PAPP-A · АФП · свободный эстриол</small>
        </span>
        <span class="prenatal-price" id="prenatalFrom">от 110 000 сум</span>
      </button>
      <p class="lead" data-i18n="hero.lead" data-i18n-html="1">Современная медицинская лаборатория с автоматическим оборудованием. Анализы крови, гормоны, онкомаркеры, бактериология, генетика и УЗИ. Результаты приходят в Telegram-бот <a href="https://t.me/nomadlabbot" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="color:#86efac;font-weight:700">@nomadlabbot</a>.</p>
      <div class="hero-buttons">
        <a href="#prices" class="btn btn-primary" data-i18n="hero.choose">Выбрать анализы</a>
        <a href="#prices" class="btn btn-outline" data-i18n="hero.price">Прайс-лист 2026</a>
      </div>
      <div class="stats">
        <div class="stat"><b id="statLab">205</b><span data-i18n="hero.stat1">анализов в прайсе</span></div>
        <div class="stat"><b id="statUsd">17</b><span data-i18n="hero.stat2">видов УЗИ</span></div>
        <div class="stat"><b>4.9 ★</b><span data-i18n="hero.stat3">рейтинг на Яндекс Картах</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="hero-card reveal">
      <div class="feed-head">
        <b data-i18n="feed.title">Спортивные чек-апы</b>
        <small id="feedCounter">1 / 1</small>
      </div>
      <div class="feed">
        <button type="button" class="feed-arrow prev" id="feedPrev" aria-label="Предыдущее видео">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M15 5l-7 7 7 7"/></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="feed-track" id="feedTrack" tabindex="0" aria-label="Лента видео, листайте влево и вправо"></div>

        </button>

</section>

        <div class="stars" id="ratingStars">★★★★★</div>

      </div>
    </div>

    </div>

    <form class="review-form reveal" id="reviewForm" novalidate>
      <h3 data-i18n="reviews.formTitle">Оставить отзыв</h3>
      <div class="form-grid">
        <div class="field">
          <label for="rName" data-i18n="reviews.yourName">Ваше имя *</label>
          <input id="rName" type="text" placeholder="Имя" autocomplete="given-name" data-i18n-ph="reviews.namePh">
          <span class="err"></span>
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label for="rSurname" data-i18n="reviews.yourSurname">Фамилия *</label>
          <input id="rSurname" type="text" placeholder="Фамилия" autocomplete="family-name" data-i18n-ph="reviews.surnamePh">
          <span class="err"></span>
        </div>
        <div class="field full">
          <label data-i18n="reviews.rating">Оценка *</label>
          <div class="star-input">
            <input type="radio" id="st5" name="stars" value="5"><label for="st5" title="5">★</label>
            <input type="radio" id="st4" name="stars" value="4"><label for="st4" title="4">★</label>
            <input type="radio" id="st3" name="stars" value="3"><label for="st3" title="3">★</label>
            <input type="radio" id="st2" name="stars" value="2"><label for="st2" title="2">★</label>
            <input type="radio" id="st1" name="stars" value="1"><label for="st1" title="1">★</label>
          </div>
          <span class="err" id="starErr"></span>
        </div>
        <div class="field full">
          <label for="rText" data-i18n="reviews.text">Отзыв *</label>
          <textarea id="rText" placeholder="Расскажите о своём опыте" data-i18n-ph="reviews.textPh"></textarea>
          <span class="err"></span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <button type="submit" class="btn btn-violet" style="margin-top:8px" data-i18n="reviews.publish">Опубликовать отзыв</button>
    </form>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="modal cart-modal" id="cartModal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="cartModalTitle">
  <div class="modal-box cart-box">
    <div class="modal-head">
      <div><h3 id="cartModalTitle" data-i18n="cart.title">Корзина</h3><small id="cartModalInfo"></small></div>
      <button type="button" class="modal-close" id="cartModalClose" aria-label="Закрыть">×</button>
    </div>
    <div class="modal-body">
      <form id="bookingForm" novalidate>
        <div id="bookingFields">
          <!-- пустая корзина -->
          <div class="cart-empty" id="cartEmpty">
            <div class="cart-empty-ico" aria-hidden="true">🛒</div>

          <div id="cartFilled">

              <span data-i18n="cart.total">Итого к оплате</span>
              <b id="cartModalTotal">0</b>
            </div>

            <div class="form-grid">
              <div class="field">
                <label for="bName" data-i18n="form.name">Имя и фамилия *</label>
                <input id="bName" name="name" type="text" placeholder="Ваше имя" autocomplete="name" data-i18n-ph="form.namePh">
                <span class="err"></span>
              </div>
              <div class="field">
                <label for="bPhone" data-i18n="form.phone">Телефон *</label>
                <input id="bPhone" name="phone" type="tel" inputmode="tel" placeholder="+998 __ ___ __ __" autocomplete="tel">
                <span class="err"></span>
              </div>
              <div class="field">
                <label for="bDate" data-i18n="form.date">Дата *</label>
                <input id="bDate" name="date" type="date">
                <span class="err"></span>
              </div>
              <div class="field">
                <label for="bTime" data-i18n="form.time">Время *</label>
                <input id="bTime" name="time" type="time">
                <span class="err"></span>
              </div>
              <div class="field full">
                <label for="bComment" data-i18n="form.comment">Комментарий</label>
                <textarea id="bComment" name="comment" placeholder="Пожелания, вопросы" data-i18n-ph="form.commentPh"></textarea>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary cart-submit" data-i18n="cart.submit">Оформить и перейти к оплате</button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- благодарность после оформления -->
        <div class="success" id="bookingSuccess">
          <div class="success-burst" aria-hidden="true">
            <span class="ring"></span><span class="ring r2"></span>
            <div class="check">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path class="check-path" d="M5 12l5 5L20 7"/></svg>
            </div>

          <ul class="success-list">
            <li class="sl s-1">
              <span class="sl-ico" aria-hidden="true">🧪</span>
              <span><small data-i18n="success.serviceLabel">Услуга</small><b id="okService">—</b></span>
            </li>
            <li class="sl s-2">
              <span class="sl-ico" aria-hidden="true">📅</span>
              <span><small data-i18n="success.whenLabel">Когда прийти</small><b id="okWhen">—</b><em id="okAddress">г. Нукус, ул. А. Досназарова, 78</em></span>

              <span><small data-i18n="success.payLabel">Оплата</small><b id="okPay">—</b></span>
            </li>
          </ul>

          <div class="btns">
            <a class="btn btn-primary" id="okPayBtn" href="https://t.me/nomadlabbot" target="_blank" rel="noopener" data-i18n="success.payBtn">Оплатить в @nomadlabbot</a>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" id="newBooking" data-i18n="success.again">Новый заказ</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

  var LANG_KEY = "nomadlab_lang";
  var lang = "ru";
  function detectLang() {
    var saved;
    try { saved = localStorage.getItem(LANG_KEY); } catch (e) {}
    if (saved && I18N[saved]) return saved;
    var nav = (navigator.languages || [navigator.language || "ru"]).join(",").toLowerCase();
    if (/\bkaa|\bkk/.test(nav)) return "kk";
    if (/\buz/.test(nav)) return "uz";
    if (/\bru/.test(nav)) return "ru";
    if (/\ben/.test(nav)) return "en";
    return "ru";
  }
  function t(key, vars) {
    var s = (I18N[lang] && I18N[lang][key]) || I18N.ru[key] || key;
    if (vars) {
      Object.keys(vars).forEach(function (k) { s = s.split("{" + k + "}").join(vars[k]); });
    }
    return s;
  }
